verdict.rationale: Shopify documents an Order MCP server that lets agents fetch an order's current state, including line items, fulfillment events and post-purchase adjustments. It also documents subscribable webhook topics for near-real-time event data and an Admin API for integrations. However, the evidence only shows reading and monitoring order status; it does not show an agent driving fulfillment or returns, and the webhook docs are generic rather than order-lifecycle specific. Missing for 10: documented APIs for an agent to create and update fulfillments, documented returns or refunds endpoints, order-lifecycle webhook topics (fulfillment and return events), and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end post-purchase flow without the admin.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can take an order through its post-purchase lifecycle — status, fulfillment, returns — via documented APIs and webhooks without a human in the admin

citations.quote: Use the Order MCP server to fetch the current state of an order placed through your agent, including line items, fulfillment events, and post-purchase adjustments.
Build AI agents that authenticate with Shopify, search the Catalog, build carts and checkouts, and monitor orders using the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP).
